subject: Procurely onboarding — intake & checklist (initial kickoff)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Asha Nair <asha@procurely.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurely onboarding — intake & checklist (initial kickoff)

Hi Asha / Procurely team,

Great to connect on the pilot — excited to get you onboarded. To kick off procurement and create the first PO, we need a few standard items from your side and I'll share what Redwood will provide. If you can return the items below by EOD next Wednesday (11/10) we should be able to issue a PO the following week.

What we need from Procurely (please attach where indicated):
- Completed vendor packet (attached PDF from Redwood; happy to accept DocuSign) — see "Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf" attached.
- Tax form: W-9 (US entity) or W-8 (if non-US) — attach PDF.
- Bank details + ACH info (separate spreadsheet or bank letter).
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (PDF).
- Company legal name and remit-to address exactly as it should appear on the PO/invoice.
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone) and preferred invoice delivery method (email/SFTP).
- A sample invoice (PDF) showing line items and billing codes you expect.
- Brief note on payment terms requested (Net 30/Net 45) and anticipated monthly spend.

What Redwood will provide back to you:
- Completed Redwood vendor form (attached) to confirm our purchase flow and contact points.
- Standard PO template and payment details once the vendor packet is approved.
- Point of contact: Laura Bennett (Procurement) for PO issuance and Monica Patel for onboarding ops.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable)

If it helps, we can accept scanned PDFs or a signed DocuSign envelope — let me know your preference. Happy to schedule a 20-minute sync if you prefer to walk through the form together.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Strategic Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Hi Asha — thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the docs. A few procurement items and timeline notes from our side: 

Procurement checklist (next steps):
- I'll run the W-9 and bank details through Finance for verification (Karthik, can you confirm the vendor code creation SLA?).
- COI accepted; please confirm the insurer name on page 1 matches the attachment (we'll need the policy number and effective dates).
- Please confirm the exact legal entity (you listed Procurely, Inc. — we'll use that on the PO).
- Provide a one-line description of goods/services for the PO: e.g., "Procurely ML data pipeline pilot — inference credits & support".
- Confirm whether invoices will reference a Redwood project code or HubSpot opportunity ID — providing the HubSpot company link helps: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Payment/PO details:
- Redwood standard is Net 30. If Procurely agrees, we'll proceed with Net 30 on the PO.
- Once Finance verifies bank details, Procurement will issue a PO (target: issued by 11/17 assuming verification completes this week).

Legal note:
- I'll loop in Legal only if payment terms or contract language deviate materially from our standard PO terms. For now, the sample invoice looks fine — no redlines flagged.

Karthik / Monica, can you confirm: vendor code creation estimate, and whether we need a DocuSign envelope on the Redwood form? Sean, if you want me to coordinate DocuSign, I can send the envelope from Procurement.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
